timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 神宗第六子，十岁即位前为均国公、延安郡王。
timeline.summary_en: Sixth son of Shenzong, titled before ascending at ten.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 年十岁即位，高太后临朝，改元元祐。
timeline.summary_en: Ascended at ten under Empress Gao's regency; era changed to Yuanyou.

timeline.title: 元祐更化
timeline.summary: 司马光等尽废新法，元祐党人当政。
timeline.summary_en: Sima Guang and others repealed the reforms wholesale as the Yuanyou faction governed.

timeline.title: 亲政绍述
timeline.summary: 太后崩，亲政，绍述熙丰新法，贬逐元祐党人。
timeline.summary_en: With the regent gone he revived Xining policies and demoted the Yuanyou faction.

timeline.title: 哲宗崩
timeline.summary: 崩，无子，端王佶即位，是为徽宗。
timeline.summary_en: Died without issue; Prince Duan succeeded as Huizong.

timeline.title: 哲宗总评
timeline.summary: 前后朝局判若两人，党争炽烈，为北宋末政之先声。
timeline.summary_en: His reign swung between two opposite governments; factional warfare foreshadowed the dynasty's collapse.

bio_md:
# 宋哲宗 · 主要事迹

赵煦为[[n-song-shen|神宗]]第六子，元丰八年（1085）以十岁即位，高太后临朝。

元祐年间（1086—1093）司马光等尽废新法，史称「元祐更化」，旧党当政而内讧不已，洛党、蜀党、朔党相攻。元祐八年（1093）高太后崩，哲宗亲政，绍述熙丰新法，贬逐元祐党人，史称「绍圣绍述」。一帝之朝，政令两番翻覆，「前后判若两人」。

元符三年（1100）哲宗崩，无子，向太后立神宗第十一子端王赵佶，是为[[n-song-hui|徽宗]]。

, ascended at ten in 1085 under the regency of Empress Gao.

During the Yuanyou years (1086-1093) Sima Guang and the conservatives repealed the reforms wholesale - the "Yuanyou restoration" - then fell to quarreling among themselves. When Empress Gao died in 1093 Zhezong took power himself, revived the Xining policies, and demoted the Yuanyou faction - the "Shaosheng revival." One reign, two opposite governments: "two different men before and after."
